title: Partner Platform Walkthrough
description: Step-by-step guide to help you get started with Knotie AI Pro
skipWarning: Skipping the walkthrough will unlock all features but you might miss important setup steps. You can restart the walkthrough anytime from Settings.

steps.title: Welcome to Knotie AI Pro
steps.description: Learn about the partner portal and platform overview
steps.instructions: Watch this welcome video to understand how the partner portal works and what you can achieve with Knotie AI Pro.

steps.title: Setup Your White-Label Portal
steps.instructions: Go to Settings → White-Label Portal and configure your portal title and branding colors.
steps.helpText: Your white-label portal allows customers to access their voice AI agents under your brand.

steps.title: Complete Your Profile Settings
steps.description: Update your business information and contact details
steps.instructions: Go to Settings → Profile Settings and ensure your business information is complete and accurate.
steps.helpText: Complete profile information helps build trust with your customers and ensures proper billing.

steps.title: Connect Your Stripe Account
steps.description: Setup payment processing for customer billing
steps.instructions: In Settings, connect your Stripe account to enable customer billing and payment processing.
steps.helpText: Stripe integration is required to bill customers for voice AI services and collect payments.

steps.title: Onboard Your First Customer
steps.description: Learn how to add and manage customers
steps.instructions: Go to Customer List and add your first customer. You can add yourself as a test customer.
steps.helpText: Customers are the end-users who will use your voice AI agents. Each customer gets their own portal access.

steps.title: Explore Customer Portal Features
steps.description: Learn about customer management and portal access
steps.instructions: In Customer List, click on a customer and explore the portal access and management features.
steps.helpText: Customer portal allows your clients to manage their voice AI agents, view analytics, and access support.

steps.title: Create Your First AI Agent
steps.description: Setup a voice AI agent using Retell AI
steps.instructions: Go to Manage AI Agents → Manage Retell Agents and create your first voice AI agent.
steps.helpText: Retell AI provides high-quality voice agents with natural conversation capabilities.

steps.title: Explore Other AI Providers
steps.description: Learn about VAPI, Ultravox, ElevenLabs and other providers
steps.instructions: Explore the different AI agent providers available in the Manage AI Agents section.
steps.helpText: Different providers offer unique features. Choose based on your specific use case and requirements.

steps.title: Understand Billing & Credits
steps.description: Learn about credit system and billing management
steps.instructions: Visit Credits and Billing sections to understand how the credit system and invoicing works.
steps.helpText: Credits are used for AI operations, telephony, and other services. Monitor usage to manage costs effectively.

steps.title: Setup Team Management
steps.description: Learn how to invite team members and manage permissions
steps.instructions: Go to Team Management to learn how to invite team members and manage their access levels.
steps.helpText: Team members can help manage customers and agents with different permission levels.
steps.completionMessage: Congratulations! You've completed the partner walkthrough. All features are now unlocked and you're ready to start building your voice AI business.

skipOptions.skipWarningMessage: You can skip this walkthrough and unlock all features immediately. However, you might miss important setup steps that could help you get started faster. You can always restart the walkthrough from Settings.

restartOptions.restartWarningMessage: This will reset your walkthrough progress and lock menu items again. Your actual data and settings will not be affected.
